title: Explaining Matters: Leveraging Definitions and Semantic Expansion for Sexism Detection
reasoning: The paper focuses on the computational task of sexism detection using NLP techniques such as data augmentation and model ensembling. While the subject of sexism carries moral and ethical weight, the study itself focuses on classification performance on a technical benchmark (EDOS) rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious beliefs, theology, or general moral/ethical frameworks.
